'''Elsho''' was the third and outermost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Garqi (star)|Garqi]] in the [[Garqi system/Legends|Garqi system]],<ref name="GW" /> located in the [[Tadrin sector/Legends|Tadrin subsector]] of the [[Cassander sector/Legends|Cassander sector]], situated within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="GW" /><ref name="EAOC" /> Elsho was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] with seven [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="GW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The worlds in the [[Garqi system/Legends|Garqi system]], except [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]], were designed for the [[2004]] sourcebook ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GW" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Garqi star system in grid square K-5.<ref name="EAOC" />
